jobs.description:
Brabantia in Pelt is looking for Warehouse Operators!
 

Are you looking for a varied job in an international company? Then we are looking for you!
 

As a Warehouse Operator, you will be responsible for the following tasks:
 

 
• Manually picking orders
 
• Packing and labelling products
 
• Processing shipping documents
 
• Working with handheld scanners 
 

You will also help keep the working environment clean and tidy. You always work safely and support your colleagues whenever needed.

As a Warehouse Operator at Brabantia, you will have a varied range of tasks.
 

 
• You are available to work in 2 shifts: from 5:30 AM to 2:00 PM and from 2:00 PM to 10:30 PM. On Fridays, the early shift is from 5:30 AM to 1:00 PM and the late shift from 1:00 PM to 8:30 PM
 
• You will work with handheld scanners and computer programs
 
• Experience with these tools or the motivation to learn how to use them is therefore essential
 
• You have experience operating an electric pallet truck or are willing to follow an internal training
 
• You have your own means of transportation, as Brabantia is not accessible by public transport
 
• You speak English fluently

Our client is a leading international group active in industrial solutions. Operating in a dynamic Benelux environment, they combine global standards with local agility. They are looking for an EHS Specialist to strengthen safety culture, support operations and projects, and drive continuous improvement across multiple entities.

Jobomschrijving

• Champion a strong safety and environmental culture
• Maintain and improve EHS systems (ISO 45001, ISO 14001, VCA)
• Support projects with safety methodologies (HAZOP, RAMS, PSSR)
• Act as EHS point of contact for operational field teams
• Conduct risk assessments, audits, and site safety reviews
• Investigate incidents and define preventive measures
• Deliver EHS training and awareness programs
• Ensure compliance with BE/NL regulations and reporting

• 2  years in EHS within an industrial or service environment
• Strong knowledge of safety regulations (Belgium required, NL is a plus)
• Experience with EHS management systems (ISO 45001 / VCA)
• Familiar with project safety tools (HAZOP, RAMS…) is a plus
• Fluent in Dutch and English; French is a strong asset
• Autonomous, pragmatic, and hands-on mindset
• Strong communicator with influencing skills

Do you have experience as a forklift driver?As the driver of the forklift truck with long forks, you are responsible for storing goods and loading/unloading the trucks. In addition, you sometimes help with other tasks in the warehouse (order picking, receiving, stock counting, etc.). For this, you will use a scanner.You will start in the Katoen Natie warehouses in Ghent.

Profile

• You have experience with a forklift truck with long forks (2m40) or you have extensive experience with a forklift truck with short forks and you see yourself driving the long-fork truck as well.
• A forklift certificate is not a requirement, experience is more important. There will be a theoretical and practical test
• To communicate effectively with your colleagues, you speak and understand Dutch or English well.
• You can work in a two-shift system
• You are motivated and reliable, and you prize safety and quality.
• You are flexible when it comes to hours and tasks
• In addition, you know how to use a scanner and a computer

Join a stable and international environment where you can keep learning, take ownership and enjoy a healthy work-life balance.

Our partner is anestablished international technology organisationoperating in a highly technical and collaborative environment.

They are looking for aSystem & Network Engineerto strengthen their infrastructure team and contribute to the reliability, security and continuous improvement of their IT environment.

What makes this opportunity stand out?You get to work on interesting infrastructure and networking challenges, while being part of a company that genuinely values work-life balance.
System & Network Engineer - Your Role
• Manage and maintainWindows & Linux systems, servers and core infrastructure.
• Configure, monitor and troubleshootnetworking environments, including switches, firewalls and related technologies.
• Contribute toinfrastructure projects, upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Ensure high levels ofavailability, performance and securityacross the IT environment.
• Investigate complex technical issues and providehands-on troubleshootingacross systems and networks.
• Collaborate with internal teams and external partners while documenting and improvingIT processes and solutions.
System & Network Engineer - Your Profile
• Several years of experience as aSystem Engineer, Network Engineer or Infrastructure Engineer.
• Solid knowledge ofWindows and/or Linuxenvironments.
• Strong understanding ofnetworking concepts, protocols and infrastructure technologies.
• Experience withvirtualisation, security or cloud technologiesis a strong plus.
• A proactive, analytical mindset with the ability totake ownershipof technical challenges.
• Comfortable working in aninternational environmentand communicating in English; additional languages are a plus.

A hands-on Network Architect role where Juniper and Fortinet meet complex, business-critical infrastructure.

Our partner is aninternational technology organisationoperating critical digital infrastructure. As part of the continued development of their infrastructure environment, they are looking for aNetwork Architectto join a highly skilled and collaborative technical team.

 

This is not a purely conceptual architecture role. You will move betweenarchitecture, design, implementation and production support, working with modern networking technologies and having a direct impact on the resilience and evolution of the infrastructure.

 

Your playground? Juniper, Fortinet, BGP, DNS, security and distributed infrastructure.
Network Architect - The Role
• Design and evolvenetwork architecturesacross complex and distributed production environments, from high-level concepts to low-level technical designs.
• Work hands-on withJuniper networking and Fortinet security technologies, including routing, switching, firewalls and network segmentation.
• Contribute toBGP, DNS/DNSSEC, high-availability and distributed infrastructure, with a strong focus on resilience and security.
• Drive improvements aroundautomation, monitoring and observability, using technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, Prometheus or Grafana.
• Collaborate withInfrastructure, Security, Architecture and Software Engineeringteams, while challenging and validating technical solutions delivered by external partners.
• Maintainarchitecture documentation, diagrams and technical standards, while supporting troubleshooting, lifecycle management and production environments.
Network Architect - The Profile
• 7+ years of experiencein network, infrastructure or systems engineering, with strong exposure to critical production environments.
• Strong expertise innetworking, including TCP/IP, routing, switching and protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
• Solid hands-on experience withJuniper and Fortinet— this is a key part of the role.
• Good understanding ofLinux, DNS/DNSSEC, firewalls and high-availability/distributed infrastructure.
• Exposure tovirtualisation, containers, private cloud or Infrastructure as Code(VMware, Kubernetes, Docker, Ansible, Terraform, etc.) is a strong plus.
• Analytical, pragmatic and hands-on mindset, with the ability to move from architecture and design to implementation and production troubleshooting. Fluent English is required.

Ready to take your GRC career beyond traditional compliance?

Our partner, an international technology organisation operating in a highly connected and evolving digital environment, is looking for an experiencedSecurity Managerto reinforce its Legal & Compliance function.

 

You'll be working in amulticultural, international setting, collaborating with different departments and stakeholders while contributing to governance, cybersecurity, privacy and regulatory initiatives.

 

A great opportunity to combine your legal and technical understanding with strategic exposure and real decision-making impact.
Security Manager - The Job
• GRC Strategy:Drive the organisation's governance, risk and compliance framework, from risk identification to mitigation and reporting.
• Security & Certifications:Manage compliance withISO 27001, ISO 22301and other relevant security and resilience frameworks.
• Regulatory Compliance:Translate European regulations such asNIS2, CER and GDPRinto actionable policies, controls and processes.
• Privacy Management:Coordinate GDPR compliance, DPIAs, privacy assessments and support the DPO in data protection governance.
• ESG & Corporate Governance:Develop ESG governance processes, monitor commitments and coordinate reporting activities.
• Stakeholder Advisory:Act as a trusted advisor to internal teams, challenge existing practices and continuously improve GRC tools and processes.
Security Manager - The Ideal Candidate
• Minimum 7 years of relevant experiencein GRC, compliance, risk management or auditing.
• Master's degree inLaw, Compliance, Risk Managementor another relevant discipline.
• Solid understanding ofinformation security governance, GDPR, ISO standards, NIS2 and CER.
• Hands-on experience withGRC platforms, risk frameworks and internal control systems.
• Native-levelDutch or French, professional proficiency in the other national language and excellent English.
• Strong communicator with an international mindset, able to influence stakeholders and manage complex topics with confidence.

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Do you enjoy variety and like to get things done?

Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

We are looking for an Administrative Assistant with over 2 years of experience in administration for our client.
 

What are your tasks?
 
 
 
• Keep agendas up-to-date and ensure consistency amongst Executives’ activities 
 
• Follow-up meetings/conferences/registrations and invitation to meetings/conferences etc.

• Team worker

Since 1854, Katoen Natie has grown from a Belgian family business into a global logistics powerhouse with operations spanning five continents. Based in the strategic Gent Port, we specialize in warehousing, transport, cargo handling, and supply chain solutions for international clients. Our success stems from combining 170  years of expertise with innovative technology and a personal, SME approach to business.Join our dynamic team where tradition meets innovation, and every day brings new challenges in the exciting world of international logistics.

Jobomschrijving

THE OPPORTUNITYWe're seeking an experienced Warehouse Team Leader to join our operations team at our state-of-the-art facility in Gent Zeehaven. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll guide, inspire, and work alongside a dedicated team of warehouse professionals while ensuring operational excellence in our fast-paced international logistics environment.YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Leadership: Coach and motivate warehouse staff to consistently achieve operational KPIs and quality standardsOperational Planning: Create efficient work schedules, allocate resources, and optimize workflow processesHands-On Management: Lead by example - work directly with your team using forklifts and warehouse equipment when neededPerformance Management: Monitor team performance, provide feedback, and implement improvement initiativesCritical Decision Making: Make quick, effective decisions during peak periods and tight deadline situationsSafety & Compliance: Ensure all safety protocols and quality standards are maintained at all timesReporting: Provide regular updates to warehouse supervisors and operational managementContinuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce operational costs

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:Essential Requirements:

3  years of team leadership experience in warehouse, logistics, or distribution environmentsForklift certification (or commitment to obtain certification within 30 days)Strong communication skills in Dutch and English (French is a plus)Proven track record of meeting KPIs and managing operational deadlinesPhysical stamina for hands-on warehouse work and extended periods on your feetFlexible schedule - ability to work various shifts including occasional weekendsProblem-solving mindset with ability to make decisions under pressure

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related field or equal through experienceExperience with WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)Knowledge of customs procedures and international shippingLean/Six Sigma certification or continuous improvement experienceMultilingual capabilities for our international client base

Are you looking for a job as a Payroll & Benefits Officer in Tienen? Combine payroll, benefits administration, HR support, and process improvement within an international organization. Ready to make an impact? Apply today!
 

As a Payroll & Benefits Officer, you play a key role within the HR team. You ensure employees receive accurate payroll processing and professional support regarding their benefits package. At the same time, you actively contribute to improving HR processes and systems.
 

This is a varied position where you combine administrative accuracy with employee interaction and collaboration with international colleagues.
 

As a Payroll & Benefits Officer, your responsibilities include:
 

 
• Managing payroll processing for employees in Belgium and gradually supporting payroll activities in other European countries.
 
• Administering a range of employee benefits, including company cars, insurance plans, pension schemes, and mobility solutions.
 
• Contributing to the optimization of payroll and HR processes and proactively identifying improvement opportunities.
 
• Ensuring the accurate registration and maintenance of employee data and HR records.
 
• Acting as the main point of contact for employees and managers regarding payroll and benefits-related questions. 
 

In addition, you work closely with payroll providers, insurance partners, and internal stakeholders. You also support reporting activities related to absenteeism, employee turnover, and other HR metrics.

 

For this Payroll & Benefits Officer position, we are looking for someone who enjoys working with figures, processes, and people. You are accurate, communicative, and thrive in an international environment.
 

You bring:
 

 
• A bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or equivalent experience.
 
• Experience in payroll, HR administration, or a similar role.
 
• An excellent command of English. Knowledge of Dutch, French, or other European languages is a strong asset.
 
• Solid MS Office skills. Experience with Workday and/or SD Worx is considered a plus.
 
• A proactive, customer-oriented, and communicative personality. 
 

In addition, you have a strong analytical mindset, enjoy working with data, and pay close attention to detail. This enables you to maintain an overview, meet deadlines, and handle confidential information with the utmost discretion.

The QP Delegate serves as a key quality assurance representative, supporting the Qualified Person (QP) in ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal quality standards for the release of commercial and clinical batches. While the QP delegate has the responsibility for approving the batch release dossier based on a detailed review of the batch release dossier content, the QP delegate relies on the pharmaceutical quality system of the site under the responsibility of the Qualified Person.
 

Key Responsibilities:
 

Quality & Batch Release
 

QP Governance & Escalation
 

Deviations & Change Control
 

Analytical & Product Specifications
 

Product Review
 

Shipment & Export
 

Reference Samples 

 
• Education: Master of Industrial Pharmacy 
 

 
• Certification: Valid QP number - recognized by the Belgian Minister of Health as Qualified Person as published in the Belgian official journal. QP initial training must be completed and kept up to date as described in QU-SOP-0037724. 
 

 
• Experience: Minimum 8–10 years in the pharmaceutical industry; prior experience as a QP is strongly preferred; extensive knowledge of and experience in biotechnology production processes

Do you have experience in logistics and a natural talent for leadership?

For a modern logistics company, we are looking for a Team Leader who can lead, motivate, and support the warehouse team while contributing daily to the smooth operation of all logistics activities.

Your Role: The Driving Force Behind the Team

As a Team Leader, you are the first point of contact for a team of warehouse operators. You ensure that all processes, from receiving goods to shipping orders, are carried out safely, efficiently, and accurately. You motivate your team, provide guidance when needed, and maintain a clear overview of daily operations.
Your Responsibilities:

 
• Leading, coaching, and supporting the logistics team on the warehouse floor
 
• Coordinating daily warehouse activities and resolving operational challenges
 
• Monitoring planning, safety, and quality standards
 
• Collaborating with other departments and proactively contributing solutions
 
• Rolling up your sleeves and assisting with operational tasks when required

 
• You have leadership experience and know how to motivate people in a positive and constructive way.
 
• You have strong communication skills and are flexible.
 
• You are fluent in English.
 
• You have experience leading a team and hold a valid forklift and/or reach truck certificate.
 
• You enjoy working in a dynamic environment with changing priorities.
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system or on a fixed night shift.

Step into a rewarding logistics role as an electric pallet truck (EPT) order picker at Logent in Evergem in a 2-shift system with competitive pay and strong benefits!

Looking for a role where your precision and energy keep logistics moving forward? As an electric pallet truck (EPT) order picker at Logent, you are at the heart of our facility. You take pride in driving efficiency, organizing stock seamlessly, and ensuring every order moves through the facility with accuracy and care.

 Apply today via 09 218 79 35 or talentcenter40@randstad.be to join the team of Logent. 

VG 458/BUOSAP

Who are we looking for? 

• Proven experience in operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT).
• In possession of a valid EPT certificate or license.
• Available and flexible to work in a rotating two-shift schedule (early and late shifts).
• Good communication skills in English to ensure clear team collaboration.
• You have your own means of transport to reach the site in Evergem. 
As an EPT order picker, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth and safe movement of goods throughout the facility.

• Navigate the facility safely using an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT) to collect and transport orders.
• Handle materials with precision during loading and unloading processes to keep stock damage-free.
• Organise and stack incoming items following exact warehouse procedures and safety guidelines.
• Assist with accurate stock tracking, inventory counts, and shelf replenishment.
